topic: How OpenAI Makes Money While Fighting Apple

youtube.title: How OpenAI Makes Money While Fighting Apple
youtube.description:
How OpenAI Makes Money While Fighting Apple: Apple owns the phone doorway. OpenAI wants the next one.

A giant glass phone stands on a dark plaza like a locked castle. Apple built that castle.

A warm June 2024 handshake sits beside a May 2026 strained-partnership report and a July 2026 trade-secret complaint that OpenAI calls wrong.

This is an illustrated documentary from How They Really Make Money.

Educational analysis of a business model. Not investment advice.

Sources / further reading:
- OpenAI and Apple announce partnership (2024)
- Introducing Apple Intelligence for iPhone, iPad, and Mac (Apple Newsroom, 2024)
- What is ChatGPT Plus? (OpenAI Help Center)
- Business Pricing (OpenAI)
- OpenAI raises $122 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI (OpenAI, 2026)
- CNBC / Bloomberg reporting on August 2026 annualized revenue run rate and enterprise mix
- Apple Inc. v. Liu, N.D. Cal. 5:26-cv-07078 (complaint filed July 10, 2026)
- Apple is getting this wrong (OpenAI, August 3, 2026)

Related: Apple can still open other helper doors. Later reporting described other chat brains being tested for the same phone castle. That is another fight for another night. This cut stays on the doorway OpenAI rented, the cash registers it actually owns, and the next gate it is trying to build. A castle that hosts many helpers is still a castle. The rent rules can change. But the key still matters, because the doorway is the prize.
